# MeedyaDL 1.4.5

A targeted follow-up to 1.4.4, fixing two rough edges from that release.

### What's fixed

- **Synced lyrics no longer go missing on companion (multi-quality) downloads.** After 1.4.4 started placing companion audio files (like a Lossless copy alongside a Dolby Atmos original) in the same folder, the step that adds the "[Explicit]"/"[Clean]" label to filenames was renaming the audio but leaving its lyrics file behind under the old name — which meant lyrics and subtitles silently failed to appear for the companion copy. Both now get renamed together.
- **The top progress bar shows real progress far more often, instead of an animated "still working" stripe with no percentage.** MeedyaDL now checks every available progress source — live download percentage first, then the current processing stage, then the last known value — before ever falling back to the generic animation. You should now see an actual percentage almost all the time, with the label showing which file is currently in progress.
